blocks.html: For those who haven’t finished their Christmas shopping or are planning to celebrate Christmas day or New Year at the mall, Robinsons Malls has released their schedule for the holidays. Be guided by the following operating hours of their Metro Manila and provincial malls:

On December 1 to 23 and December 26 to 30, Robinsons Place Las Piñas, Robinsons Place Manila and Robinsons Magnolia, will be extending their mall hours until 11pm while Robinsons Place Malolos will extend up to 12 midnight; On December 19, Robinsons Starmills Pampanga will only be open until 12nn for the Giant Lantern Festival; Robinsons Malls that will close early at 8pm on Christmas Eve are Robinsons Galleria, Robinsons Place Las Piñas, Robinsons Metro East, Robinsons Luisita, Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Place Pangasinan, Robinsons Place Santiago and Robinsons Starmills. Closing at 7pm on December 24 are Robinsons Angeles and Robinsons Ilocos; On Christmas Day, most Robinson Malls will observe regular operating hours except for Robinsons Magnolia and Robinsons Place Manila (10am to 11pm) and Robinsons Place Pangasinan (9am to 8pm).

Early closing hours on December 31 will be observed in some Robinsons Malls: Robinsons Place Las Piñas, Robinsons Town Mall Malabon, Robinsons Luisita, Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Place Pangasinan, Robinsons Place Santiago, Robinsons Starmills Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Cainta will close at 8pm while Robinsons Place Manila, Robinsons Metro East, Robinsons Angeles and Robinsons Ilocos will close at 7pm.
All Robinsons Malls will open at 12nn on New Year except for Robinsons Place Las Piñas (opening at 11am), Robinsons Luisita (opening at 8am) and Summit Ridge Promenade (opening at 10am).
